passages.context: The complete apostolic letter was inspected, including its approval of the revised calendar and Universal Norms and the stated date on which the new arrangement took effect.
passages.notes: Artifact page 64 contains both the conclusion of Mysterii Paschalis and the beginning of the Universal Norms, so this passage intentionally overlaps the next constituent segment.
